headline: Data center boom could wipe out years of US emissions progress, report warns
summary: A new Sierra Club analysis warns that the data center boom could wipe out about 15 years of US progress on cutting greenhouse gas emissions. The group projects that by 2030, data center-driven buildouts could make the US power sector emit as much carbon dioxide as all of Mexico, with sector-wide CO2 pollution potentially up 42 percent compared with 2025 as utilities expand fossil fuel infrastructure to meet rising electricity demand from data centers.
